titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Oath, the Water and the Dream of the Sun (ch. 30)
part: ch. 30 — The Oath, the Water and the Dream of the Sun
about: Solomon and the Queen swear a mutual oath: he will not overpower her, and she will not take anything from his house by force. They lie in one room, and he sets a trap: a jar of water, a servant told in another tongue to sleep, and a ceiling of lights. Thirsty, she rises to drink and he catches her hand, saying she has broken the oath; she answers that she has wronged herself and frees him from his oath, and he lets her drink, and they sleep together. Solomon then dreams of a sun that leaves Israel for Ethiopia, and of a second sun that Israel tries to put out, which rises again and lights the world. He wakes shaken, the Queen asks to go home, and he sends her off with great wealth and wonderful carts.

sentences.t: ፴ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘመሐለ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።
sentences.l: 30. Concerning that-which swore to-her king Solomon.
sentences.i: Chapter 30: Concerning the Oath King Solomon Swore to Her
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፴ is 30 (spoken ሠላሳ, śälasa). በእንተ 'concerning' governs the relative clause ዘመሐለ 'that which he swore' (ዘ- relative + መሐለ 'swear', perfect 3rd masculine singular); ላቲ is 'to her' (ለ- + ቲ); ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን 'King Solomon' follows as the subject, without an article.

sentences.t: አውሥኣ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ እምሕል ፡ ለኪ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትኀየልኪ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ አንቲኒ ፡ መሐሊ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትትኀየሊ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ቤትየ ፤
sentences.l: He-answered-her and-he-said-to-her: I-will-swear to-you that not he-overpower-you, but you-too swear that not you-take-by-force everything which-in house-my;
sentences.i: He answered her and said: "I will swear to you that I will not overpower you; but you also must swear that you will not take by force anything that is in my house."
sentences.n: አውሥኣ 'he answered her' (አውሥአ + -ኣ 'her'); ወይቤላ 'and he said to her' (ይቤ + -ላ). The speaker is Solomon, replying to her demand at the end of ch. 29. እምሕል is the 1st singular imperfect (subjunctive) of መሐለ 'swear', with the እ- prefix; ለኪ 'to you' (feminine). ከመ ኢይትኀየልኪ: ከመ 'that' + negative + ተኀየለ 'prevail over, use force against' + -ኪ 'you'. The verb is 3rd masculine (ይ-), where I would expect 1st person (እ-) for Solomon speaking of himself; I read it as 'I' (?), the oath being phrased impersonally. ወባሕቱ 'but'; አንቲኒ 'you also' (አንቲ + -ኒ); መሐሊ is the feminine imperative of መሐለ; ኢትትኀየሊ 'that you not take by force' (2nd feminine). ኵሎ ዘውስተ ቤትየ: ኵሎ 'all' + ዘ- 'that which' + ውስተ 'in' + ቤትየ 'my house'.

sentences.t: ወሰሐቀት ፡ ንግሥት ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ጠቢብ ፡ አንተ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ከመ ፡ አብድ ፡ ትትናገር ፤
sentences.l: And-she-laughed, queen, and-she-said-to-him: While wise you, why like fool you-speak?
sentences.i: The Queen laughed and said to him: "You are wise. Why do you speak like a fool?"
sentences.n: ሰሐቀ 'laugh'; ወትቤሎ 'and she said to him' (ትቤ is 3rd feminine of ይቤ). ንግሥት is a title, not a name. እንዘ + noun clause 'while, being' (circumstantial): እንዘ ጠቢብ አንተ 'while you are wise'. ለምንት 'why'. ከመ አብድ 'like a fool' (አብድ 'foolish, mad'). ትትናገር 'you speak' (ተናገረ 'converse, speak', 2nd masculine imperfect).

sentences.t: እሰርቅኑ ፡ ወሚመ ፡ አሀይድ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዘኢወሀበኒ ፡ ንጉሥ ፤
sentences.l: Shall-I-steal or-shall-I-plunder house-of king which-not he-gave-me king?
sentences.i: "Shall I steal, or plunder a king's house, which the king has not given me?"
sentences.n: Two questions in one: እሰርቅኑ 'shall I steal?' (ሰረቀ 'steal', 1st singular imperfect + the question particle -ኑ); ወሚመ 'or'; አሀይድ 'shall I plunder' (ሀየደ 'plunder, rob'). ቤተ ንጉሥ 'house of a king' (construct, accusative). ዘኢወሀበኒ ንጉሥ: ዘ- 'which' + ኢ 'not' + ወሀበ 'give' + -ኒ 'me'; ንጉሥ is the subject, 'the king'. She means that she would never take what he has not offered.

sentences.t: ኢይምሰልከ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ በፍቅረ ፡ ንዋይ ፡ ዘመጻእኩ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ወመንግሥትየኒ ፡ ብዕልት ፡ በጸጋከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትኀጥአኒ ፡ እምዘ ፡ ፈቀድኩ ፤
sentences.l: Let-not-it-seem-to-you, my-lord, that-for-love-of goods I-came here, and-my-kingdom-too rich by-your-grace, and-there-is-not what fails-me of-what I-wished;
sentences.i: "Do not suppose, my lord, that I came here out of love of goods. My own kingdom is rich by your grace, and nothing I desired is lacking to me;
sentences.n: ኢይምሰልከ 'let it not seem to you' (መሰለ 'seem, appear', jussive, + -ከ 'to you'); እግዚእየ 'my lord'. በፍቅረ ንዋይ 'out of love of goods' (በ- 'by, from'; ፍቅር in the construct; ንዋይ 'goods, property'). ዘመጻእኩ ዝየ 'that I came here' (ዘ- as 'that' after መሰለ; መጽአ 'come', 1st singular). መንግሥትየኒ 'my kingdom too' (መንግሥት 'kingdom' + -የ 'my' + -ኒ 'also'); ብዕልት 'rich' (feminine). በጸጋከ 'by your grace, bounty'. ወአልቦ ዘይትኀጥአኒ: አልቦ 'there is not' + ዘ- 'what' + ይትኀጥአኒ 'fails me, is lacking to me' (ተኀጥአ, of ኀጥአ 'miss, fail'; the stem sense is my reading (?)); እምዘ ፈቀድኩ 'of what I wished' (ፈቀደ 'wish', 1st singular).

sentences.t: አላ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ መጻእኩ ፡ በኀሢሠ ፡ ጥበብከ ።
sentences.l: but only I-came in-seeking wisdom-your.
sentences.i: I came only to seek your wisdom."
sentences.n: አላ ዳእሙ 'but only'. በኀሢሠ 'in seeking' (በ- + the infinitive of ኀሠሠ 'seek'); ጥበብከ 'your wisdom' (ጥበብ + -ከ).

sentences.t: ወይቤላ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አንቲ ፡ አምሐልክኒ ፡ መሐሊ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወማሕላሰ ፡ ይደሉ ፡ ለ፪ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትዓመፁ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-her: If you you-made-me-swear, swear to-me; and-the-oath, it-is-fitting for-two that-not they-wrong-one-another;
sentences.i: He said to her: "If you have made me swear, then swear to me as well. An oath is proper for both, so that neither wrongs the other;
sentences.n: ለእመ 'if'; አምሐልክኒ 'you made me swear' (አምሐለ 'cause to swear, adjure' + -ኒ 'me'; the ending -ከ is the masculine 'you', though the Queen, አንቲ, is meant, so the text levels the two genders (?)); መሐሊ ሊተ 'swear to me' (feminine imperative of መሐለ; ሊተ 'to me'). ማሕላሰ 'as for an oath' (ማሕላ + contrastive -ሰ). ይደሉ 'it is fitting' (ደለወ 'be fitting, right'). ለ፪ is the numeral 2 with ለ- 'for', spoken ለክልኤቱ (lä-kəlʾētu) 'for the two' (the parties). ከመ ኢይትዓመፁ 'that they not wrong each other' (reciprocal ተ-stem of ዐመፀ 'do wrong, act unjustly'; the long ዓ is a spelling variant of ዐ).

sentences.t: ወለእመ ፡ ኢያምሐልክኒ ፡ ኢያምሕለኪ ፡ አነሂ ።
sentences.l: and-if not you-make-me-swear, not I-make-you-swear, I-too.
sentences.i: and if you do not make me swear, I will not make you swear either."
sentences.n: ኢያምሐልክኒ 'you do not make me swear' (አምሐለ, negated); ኢያምሕለኪ 'I will not make you swear' (3rd masculine form again, here read as 'I' as in the first unit (?)); አነሂ 'I also' (አነ + -ሂ). The meaning is plain: the oath must bind both, or neither.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎ ፡ መሐል ፡ ሊተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትትኀየለኒ ፡ ወአነሂ ፡ እምሕል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትኀየል ፡ ንዋየከ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-him: Swear to-me that not you-overpower-me, and-I-too I-will-swear that not he-take-by-force goods-your;
sentences.i: She said to him: "Swear to me that you will not overpower me, and I in turn will swear that I will not take your goods by force."
sentences.n: መሐል 'swear!' (masculine imperative); ኢትትኀየለኒ 'that you not overpower me' (as in the previous part). ወአነሂ እምሕል 'and I too will swear'. ከመ ኢይትኀየል ንዋየከ: the verb is again 3rd masculine ('that he not take by force') where 'I' is meant (?); ንዋየከ 'your goods' (accusative). The same person-shift in the oath formula occurs three times, which suggests a fixed way of phrasing an oath rather than a slip.

sentences.t: ወመሐለ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወአምሐላ ፨
sentences.l: and-he-swore to-her and-he-made-her-swear.
sentences.i: So he swore to her and had her swear.
sentences.n: መሐለ ላቲ 'he swore to her'; ወአምሐላ 'and he made her swear' (አምሐለ, causative, + -ኣ 'her'). The unit ends at ፨, the stronger mark of division, here closing the oath.

sentences.t: ወዐርገ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ምስካቡ ፡ በ፩ ፡ ገጽ ፡ ወላቲኒ ፡ አስተዳለዉ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ምስካበ ፡ በ፩ ፡ ገጽ ።
sentences.l: And-he-went-up, king, onto bed-his on one side, and-for-her-too they-prepared for-her bed on one side.
sentences.i: The king went up onto his bed on one side (of the room?), and for her too they prepared a bed on one side.
sentences.n: ወዐርገ 'and he went up' (ዐርገ 'ascend, mount'). ምስካብ 'bed, couch' (from ሰከበ 'lie down'). በ፩ ገጽ: the numeral ፩ is 'one', spoken አሐዱ (ʾaḥadu), agreeing with masculine ገጽ 'face, side, place': 'on one side', or 'in one place' (?). It is not clear whether the two beds stand at the same side of the room (so close together) or each at a side of its own; I keep the literal 'on one side' for both. ወላቲኒ 'and for her too' (ለ- + ቲ + -ኒ). አስተዳለዉ 'they prepared' (አስተዳለወ, 3rd masculine plural).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ለሕፃን ፡ ገብር ፡ ኅፅብ ፡ መቃልደ ፡ ወደይ ፡ ጻሕበ ፡ ማይ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትሬኢ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ ወዕጸው ፡ ኀዋኅወ ፡ ወኑም ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him, to-the-boy servant: Wash jars-(?) and-put bowl of-water while she-sees queen, and-shut doors and-sleep;
sentences.i: He said to a young servant: "Wash the jars (?) and set a bowl of water out while the Queen watches; then shut the doors and go to sleep."
sentences.n: ሕፃን ገብር 'young servant' (ሕፃን 'child, boy'; ገብር 'servant'), with ለ- as the marker of the person addressed. All the verbs are imperatives: ኅፅብ (ኀፀበ 'wash'), ደይ (ወደየ 'put, set'), ዕጸው (ዐጸወ 'close'), ኑም (ኖመ 'sleep'). መቃልድ is the plural of መቅለድ, which I take as a water-jar or similar vessel (?), because the next unit has the Queen lifting 'the water of the መቅለድ' to drink; ኅፅብ is plainly the imperative of ኀፀበ 'wash'; what is washed, መቃልድ, is the uncertain part, so 'wash the jars' is a guess. ጻሕብ 'bowl' (?), probably a vessel for water. እንዘ ትሬኢ ንግሥት 'while the Queen sees' (ትሬኢ 3rd feminine of ርእየ). ኀዋኅው 'doors' (plural of ኆኅት).

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ዘይቤሎ ፡ በካልእ ፡ ልሳን ፡ ዘኢታአምር ፡ ንግሥት ፤
sentences.l: And-this which he-said-to-him in other language which-not she-knows, queen;
sentences.i: He said this to him in another language, one the Queen did not know.
sentences.n: ዘንተ 'this' (accusative, object of ይቤሎ). ዘይቤሎ 'which he said to him' (ዘ- + ይቤ + -ሎ). ካልእ ልሳን 'another language' (ካልእ 'other, second'; ልሳን 'tongue, language'). ዘኢታአምር ንግሥት 'which the Queen does not know' (አእመረ 'know', 3rd feminine imperfect). So the servant is told, in a language she cannot follow, to wash, set out the water and sleep, so that the Queen does not know what has been arranged (my inference).

sentences.t: ወገብረ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ወኖመ ።
sentences.l: And-he-did likewise and-he-slept.
sentences.i: The servant did as he was told and went to sleep.
sentences.n: ገብረ 'did'; ከማሁ 'likewise, in the same way' (ከማ + -ሁ). ኖመ 'he slept' (ኖመ, root n-w-m). The subject, the servant, is not named; it has to be taken from the previous unit.

sentences.t: ወንጉሥሰ ፡ ዓዲሁ ፡ ኢኖመ ፡ ወይሬሲ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንዉም ፡ ወያስተሓይጽ ፤
sentences.l: And-the-king-indeed, still, not he-slept, and-he-made himself like one-sleeping and-he-watched;
sentences.i: But the king was not yet asleep; he made himself seem to be sleeping, and he kept watch (?).
sentences.n: ወንጉሥሰ 'and the king, for his part' (-ሰ contrastive); ዓዲሁ 'still, yet' (ዓዲ + -ሁ); ኢኖመ 'did not sleep'. ይሬሲ ርእሶ ከመ ንዉም 'he makes himself like a sleeper' (ረሰየ 'make'; ርእሶ 'himself', literally 'his head'; ንዉም 'sleeping'). ያስተሓይጽ is the causative-reflexive of an unclear root; I take it as 'watch closely, peer' (?), because in unit 17 the Queen does the same thing before she looks toward him.

sentences.t: ወቤቱሰ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሌሊተኒ ፡ ብርህት ፡ ከመ ፡ መዐልት ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ባሕርያተ ፡ ብሩሃተ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወወርኅ ፡ ወከዋክብት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጠፈረ ፡ ቤቱ ፨
sentences.l: And-house-his-indeed, of-Solomon king, even-by-night bright like day, because he-made by-wisdom pearls(?) shining, likenesses of-sun and-moon and-stars, in vault-of his-house;
sentences.i: Now the house of King Solomon was bright even at night, like day, because by his wisdom he had made shining pearls (?), likenesses of sun, moon and stars, in the vault of his house.
sentences.n: ወቤቱሰ ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'and his house, that of King Solomon' (the possessor is given with ለ-, after the suffixed noun). ሌሊተኒ 'even by night' (ሌሊት + -ኒ); ብርህት 'bright' (feminine, agreeing with ቤት). እስመ ገብረ በጥበብ 'because he made by wisdom'. ባሕርያት (plural of ባሕርይ) means 'natures' or 'pearls'; I take 'pearls' (?), the sense Dillmann gives for it, since the things made are bright and are likenesses of the heavenly bodies. አምሳለ 'likenesses of' (construct of አምሳል). ጠፈረ ቤቱ 'vault of his house' (ጠፈር 'firmament, vault'). A sun-moon-stars ceiling: the house gives light by night, which is what lets him watch her. Unit ends at ፨.

sentences.t: ወንግሥትኒ ፡ ኖመት ፡ ንስቲተ ፡ ወሶበ ፡ ነቅሀት ፡ የብሰ ፡ አፉሃ ፡ በጽምእ ፡ እስመ ፡ በጥበቡ ፡ ዘወሀባ ፡ መጻምአ ፡ ወፈድፋደ ፡ ጸምአት ፡ ወየብሰ ፡ አፉሃ ፡ ወአርመስመሰት ፡ አፉሃ ፡ ወኢረከበት ፡ ጠለ ፤
sentences.l: And-queen-too she-slept a-little, and-when she-woke dried mouth-her with-thirst, because by-his-wisdom which-he-gave-her thirst-causing(?), and-exceedingly she-thirsted, and-dried mouth-her and-grew-rough(?) mouth-her and-not she-found dew;
sentences.i: The Queen also slept a little, and when she woke her mouth was dry with thirst, since by his wisdom what he had given her was thirst-making (?). She was exceedingly thirsty; her mouth was dry and parched (?), and she found no moisture.
sentences.n: ወንግሥትኒ 'and the Queen too'; ኖመት 'she slept'; ንስቲተ 'a little'. ሶበ ነቅሀት 'when she awoke' (ነቅሀ). የብሰ አፉሃ 'her mouth was dry' (የብሰ 'be dry'; አፍ 'mouth' + -ሃ 'her'). መጻምእ I take as a noun 'thing that causes thirst' (መ- + ጸምአ 'be thirsty'), so 'because by his wisdom what he gave her was thirst-making' (?); this refers back to the spiced food sent to her in ch. 29, a deliberate stratagem, and the parse of ዘወሀባ መጻምአ is a guess. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. አርመስመሰት is a four-radical verb I cannot place with certainty; 'her mouth grew rough, parched' is a guess from the context (?). ኢረከበት ጠለ 'she found no dew', that is, no moisture (ጠል 'dew').

sentences.t: ወኀለየት ፡ ሰቲየ ፡ ማይ ፡ ዘርእየት ፡ ወአስተሓየጸት ፡ ወነጸረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወመሰላ ፡ ዘኖመ ፡ ጽኑዐ ፡ ንዋመ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-thought of-drinking water which she-saw, and-she-peered and-she-looked toward king Solomon, and-it-seemed-to-her that-he-slept sound sleep;
sentences.i: She thought of drinking the water she had seen; she peered and looked toward King Solomon, and it seemed to her that he was sound asleep.
sentences.n: ኀለየት 'she thought, considered' (ኀለየ), with ሰቲየ ማይ 'drinking of water' (the infinitive of ሰትየ). ዘርእየት 'which she had seen' (ርእየ, 3rd feminine). አስተሓየጸት ወነጸረት 'she peered and looked' (ነጸረ 'look'; the first verb as in unit 14, (?)). መሰላ 'it seemed to her' (መሰለ + -ላ). ዘኖመ ጽኑዐ ንዋመ 'that he slept a deep sleep' (ጽኑዕ 'firm, deep'; ንዋም 'sleep', a cognate accusative).

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ኢኖመ ፡ አላ ፡ ይጸንሕ ፡ እስከ ፡ ትትነሣእ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስርቅ ፡ ማየ ፡ ለጽምአ ።
sentences.l: and-he-indeed not he-slept, but he-waited until she-rise that she-steal water for-thirst.
sentences.i: But he was not asleep; he was waiting for her to get up and steal water for her thirst.
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'but he'; ኢኖመ 'did not sleep'; አላ 'but'. ይጸንሕ 'he waits' (ጸንሐ 'wait, be on the watch'); እስከ ትትነሣእ 'until she rises' (ተንሥአ). ከመ ትስርቅ ማየ 'that she steal water'. ለጽምአ 'for thirst' (ለ- + ጽምእ in the accusative form ጽምአ, with the first-order አ; the suffix 'her' would be -ኣ or -ሃ, so it is not 'her thirst' in the Geʿez, though the Queen's thirst is meant). The test is plain: he has set the water as a trap for the oath.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢታደምፅ ፡ በእገሪሃ ፡ ወሖረት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ማየ ፡ መቅለድ ፡ ወአንሥአት ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስተይ ፡ ማየ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-rose while not she-makes-noise with-her-feet, and-she-went to that water-of jar-(?), and-she-lifted that she-drink water;
sentences.i: She rose without making a sound with her feet, went to the water in the jar (?), and lifted it to drink.
sentences.n: ወተንሥአት 'and she rose'. እንዘ ኢታደምፅ 'while not making a sound' (አደመፀ, from ድምፅ 'sound, voice'); በእገሪሃ 'with her feet'. ወሖረት ኀበ 'and she went to'; ውእቱ ማየ መቅለድ 'that water of the መቅለድ' (construct), the same vessel as in unit 11 (?). ወአንሥአት 'and she lifted' (አንሥአ, causative of ተንሥአ), with no object given; I supply the vessel. ከመ ትስተይ 'that she drink' (ሰትየ).

sentences.t: ወአኀዛ ፡ እዴሃ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ትስተይ ፡ ማየ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ለምንት ፡ ተዐደውኪ ፡ ማሕላ ፡ ዘመሐልኪ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትትኀየሊ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ቤትየ ።
sentences.l: And-he-seized her-hand before she-drink water, and-he-said-to-her: Why have-you-transgressed oath which you-swore that not you-take-by-force everything which-in house-my?
sentences.i: He seized her hand before she drank, and said to her: "Why have you broken the oath you swore, that you would not take by force anything in my house?"
sentences.n: አኀዛ እዴሃ 'he seized her hand' (አኀዘ 'seize', with an object suffix -ኣ and the noun እዴሃ 'her hand' in apposition). ዘእንበለ ትስተይ ማየ 'before she drank water' (ዘእንበለ + imperfect, 'before'). ወይቤላ 'and he said to her'. ለምንት 'why'; ተዐደውኪ 'you have transgressed' (ተዐደወ 'overstep, transgress', 2nd feminine perfect); ዘመሐልኪ 'which you swore'; the remainder repeats the oath of unit 1.

sentences.t: ወአውሥአት ፡ በፍርሀት ፡ ወትበ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ተዐድዎ ፡ ማሕላ ፡ በሰቲየ ፡ ማይ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-answered in-fear and-she-said: Is-there transgression-of oath in-drinking water?
sentences.i: She answered in fear and said: "Is it a breach of the oath to drink water?"
sentences.n: በፍርሀት 'in fear'. ወትበ is a spelling of ወትቤ 'and she said' (cf. ወትበሎ in units 25 and 39, where ትቤሎ is expected) (?). ቦኑ 'is there?' (ቦ 'there is' + -ኑ). ተዐድዎ ማሕላ 'transgression of the oath' (a verbal noun with its object); በሰቲየ ማይ 'in drinking water'.

sentences.t: ወይቤላ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ዘርኢኪ ፡ ዘይኄይስ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማይ ፡ በታሕተ ፡ ሰማይ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-her, king: Is-there what you-saw which is-better than water under heaven?
sentences.i: The king said to her: "Have you seen anything under heaven better than water?"
sentences.n: ቦኑ 'is there?'; ዘርኢኪ 'what you have seen' (ዘ- + ርእየ, 2nd feminine); ዘይኄይስ 'which is better' (ኀየሰ 'be good', imperfect, comparative with እምነ 'than'). በታሕተ ሰማይ 'under heaven'. His point is that water is the best thing there is, so she has taken something of great worth: the oath concerned 'everything in my house', not just trifles. The inference is mine, not stated.

sentences.t: ወትበ ፡ አበስኩ ፡ ለርእስየ ፡ ወአንተሰ ፡ ንጹሕ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማሕላ ፡ ወኅድገኒ ፡ እስተይ ፡ ማየ ፡ ለጽምእየ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-said: I-have-sinned against-myself, and-you-indeed free of-oath; and-let-me I-drink water for-my-thirst;
sentences.i: She said: "I have done wrong to myself, but you are free of the oath. Let me drink water for my thirst."
sentences.n: ወትበ again for ወትቤ (?). አበስኩ 'I have sinned, done wrong' (አበሰ), ለርእስየ 'against myself' (ርእስ 'head, self' + -የ). ወአንተሰ 'but you' (-ሰ contrastive); ንጹሕ 'clean, free' (ንጹሕ እምነ 'free from'). She releases him from the oath she imposed, and asks to drink. ኅድገኒ 'let me / leave me' (ኀደገ, imperative + -ኒ) followed by the subjunctive እስተይ 'that I drink'; ለጽምእየ 'for my thirst'.

sentences.t: ወይቤላ ፡ ዮጊኬ ፡ ኮንኩኑ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ እማሕላኪ ፡ ዘአምሐልክኒ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-her: Then am-I-become free of-your-oath which you-made-me-swear?
sentences.i: He said to her: "Then am I free of your oath, which you made me swear?"
sentences.n: ዮጊኬ is 'then, in that case' (?); I could not confirm the word. ኮንኩኑ 'have I become?' (ኮነ 'become, be', 1st singular perfect + the question particle -ኑ). ንጹሐ is the accusative of ንጹሕ 'free', as a predicate after ኮነ. እማሕላኪ 'from your oath' (እም- + ማሕላ + -ኪ); ዘአምሐልክኒ 'which you made me swear'. He wants the release said openly.

sentences.t: ወትበሎ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ ኩን ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ እማሕላ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ ኅድገኒ ፡ እስተይ ፡ ማየ ።
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-him, queen: Be free of-the-oath, but let-me I-drink water.
sentences.i: The Queen said to him: "Be free of the oath; only let me drink water."
sentences.n: ወትበሎ for ወትቤሎ (?); ኩን 'be' (imperative of ኮነ), ንጹሐ 'free'; ወባሕቱ 'but, only'.

sentences.t: ወኀደጋ ፡ ትስተይ ፡ ማየ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ሰትየት ፡ ማየ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ወኖሙ ፡ ኅቡረ ፨
sentences.l: And-he-let-her drink water, and-after she-drank water he-did will-his, and-they-slept together.
sentences.i: He let her drink water, and after she drank he did what he wished, and they slept together.
sentences.n: ኀደጋ 'he let her' (ኀደገ + -ኣ); ትስተይ ማየ 'that she drink water' (3rd feminine subjunctive). እምድኅረ 'after'. ገብረ ፈቃዶ 'he did his will', the narrator's plain, restrained way of saying it. ኖሙ ኅቡረ 'they slept together' (ኖሙ 'they slept', 3rd masculine plural; ኅቡረ 'together'). Ends at ፨.

sentences.t: ወእምድኅረ ፡ ኖመ ፡ አስተርአዮ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ብሩህ ፡ ወረደት ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ ወአብርሀት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ፈድፋደ ፤
sentences.l: And-after he-slept appeared to-him, to-Solomon king, sun shining; she-descended from-heavens and-she-shone over Israel exceedingly;
sentences.i: After he slept, a bright sun appeared to King Solomon; it came down from the heavens and shone over Israel exceedingly.
sentences.n: አስተርአዮ ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ 'there appeared to him, to King Solomon' (አስተርአየ 'appear', the suffix -ዮ 'to him' anticipating the noun). ፀሐይ ብሩህ 'a shining sun' (ብሩህ masculine adjective), yet the verbs ወረደት, አብርሀት are feminine: ፀሐይ can be treated as feminine. አብርሀ 'shine'. ላዕለ እስራኤል 'over Israel'. ፈድፋደ 'exceedingly'. This begins Solomon's dream.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ጐንዲያ ፡ ግብተ ፡ ተመሥጠት ፡ ወሰረረት ፡ እስከ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወአብርሀት ፡ በህየኒ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ እስመ ፡ አፍቀረት ፡ ነቢረ ፡ ህየ ፤
sentences.l: And-then, having-lingered(?), suddenly she-was-snatched-away and-sped(?) to land-of Ethiopia and-shone there-too exceedingly forever because she-loved to-dwell there;
sentences.i: Then, after a delay (?), she was suddenly snatched away and sped (?) to the land of Ethiopia, and shone there exceedingly, forever, because she loved to dwell there;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then'. ጐንዲያ is a converb (-ያ, feminine agreement) of ጐንደየ 'linger, delay', so 'having lingered' (?); the ending is matched by ጐንዲዮ (masculine) in unit 30. ግብተ 'suddenly'. ተመሥጠት 'she was snatched away' (ተመሥጠ). ሰረረት 'she sped, passed on' (?). እስከ ብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'as far as the land of Ethiopia' (ብሔር 'land' in the construct, accusative). በህየኒ 'there also' (በ- + ህየ + -ኒ). እስከ ለዓለም 'for ever'. እስመ አፍቀረት ነቢረ ህየ 'because she loved to dwell there' (አፍቀረ 'love', ነቢረ 'to dwell'). The sun leaves Israel for Ethiopia; the passage does not interpret the image.

sentences.t: ወጐንደይኩ ፡ እመ ፡ ትገብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወኢገብአት ፤
sentences.l: And-I-waited whether she-would-return to Israel, and-not she-returned;
sentences.i: And I waited to see whether she would return to Israel, but she did not return;
sentences.n: ጐንደይኩ 'I lingered, waited' (1st singular perfect). The narration slips into Solomon's own voice, retelling the dream: 'I waited'. እመ ትገብእ 'whether she would return' (እመ 'if, whether'; ገብአ 'return', 3rd feminine imperfect). ወኢገብአት 'and she did not return' (3rd feminine perfect).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ጐንዲዮ ፡ ሠረቀ ፡ ብርሃን ፡ ወወረደ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እምሰማያት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወአብርሀ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ እምቀዲሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-again, having-lingered, arose light, and-descended sun from-heavens into land-of Judah and-shone exceedingly than-before;
sentences.i: Again, after a delay (?), a light arose, and a sun came down from the heavens into the land of Judah and shone more brightly than before;
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'. ጐንዲዮ 'having lingered', masculine, agreeing with ብርሃን (see unit 28) (?). ሠረቀ 'arose, rose' (of the sun and light). ወረደ ፀሐይ: here the verb is masculine, in unit 27 feminine. ብሔረ ይሁዳ 'land of Judah'. እምቀዲሙ 'than before' (እም- comparative + ቀዲሙ 'previously'). Readers of the book take this second sun as Christ, the tradition the next units point to, but the passage itself only says 'sun'.

sentences.t: ወእስራኤልሰ ፡ አስተአከይዎ ፡ ለፀሐይ ፡ እምላህቡ ፡ ወኢሖሩ ፡ በብርሃኑ ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ተሀየዮሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወእሙንቱሂ ፡ ቀንኡ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወተስእነ ፡ ሰላም ፡ ማእከሌሆሙ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ፀሐይ ፤
sentences.l: And-Israel-indeed they-despised sun because-of-his-blaze(?), and-not they-walked by-his-light, and-that-too sun turned-away(?)-them, to-Israel, and-they-indeed they-were-jealous against-him, and-became-impossible peace between-them and-between sun;
sentences.i: But Israel despised the sun, because of its blaze (?), and did not walk by its light. That sun, in its turn, turned away from Israel (?), and they were jealous of it, and peace between them and the sun became impossible (?).
sentences.n: ወእስራኤልሰ 'but Israel' (-ሰ contrastive). አስተአከይዎ ለፀሐይ 'they despised the sun' (አስተአከየ 'despise', 3rd plural + -ዎ 'him', then the noun with ለ-). እምላህቡ 'from his blaze' (ላህብ 'flame, blaze'), read as the reason (?). ወኢሖሩ በብርሃኑ 'and did not walk by his light' (ሖረ 'go, walk'). ተሀየዮሙ ለእስራኤል: a ተ-stem 3rd masculine singular perfect with the suffix -ዮሙ 'them', and ለእስራኤል in apposition; I cannot identify the root (the word recurs in unit 35). 'Turned away from' is a guess from the context; 'was angry with' would suit as well (?). ቀንኡ ላዕሌሁ 'they were jealous against him' (ቀንአ 'be zealous, jealous'). ተስእነ ሰላም 'peace became impossible' (ሰአነ 'be unable' (?)); ማእከሌሆሙ ወማእከለ ፀሐይ 'between them and between the sun'.

sentences.t: ወአንሥኡ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ምስለ ፡ አብትር ፡ ወመጣብሕ ፡ ወፈቀዱ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያጥፍእዎ ፡ ለፀሐይ ፡ ወአጽለምዋ ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ዓለም ፡ በድልቅልቅ ፡ ወጊሜ ፡ ወመሰሎሙ ፡ ዘኢይሠርቅ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ዳግመ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-raised hands-their against-him with clubs(?) and-knives, and-they-wished that they-extinguish sun, and-they-darkened all world with-quaking and-gloom, and-it-seemed-to-them that-not it-rise for-them again;
sentences.i: They raised their hands against it, with clubs (?) and knives, and wanted to put out the sun. They darkened the whole world with quaking and gloom, and it seemed to them that it would never rise for them again.
sentences.n: አንሥኡ እደዊሆሙ ላዕሌሁ 'they raised their hands against him' (አንሥአ; እደዊሆሙ 'their hands'). ምስለ 'with'. አብትር I read as 'clubs, cudgels' (?) and መጣብሕ as 'knives' (plural of መጥባሕት 'knife', from ጠብሐ 'slaughter'); the first is uncertain. ያጥፍእዎ ለፀሐይ 'that they extinguish the sun' (አጥፍአ 'put out, destroy'). አጽለምዋ ለኵሉ ዓለም 'they darkened the whole world' (አጽለመ); the subject is literally 'they', the Israelites. ድልቅልቅ 'quaking, shaking'; ጊሜ 'gloom, darkness'. መሰሎሙ ዘኢይሠርቅ 'it seemed to them that it would not rise' (as መሰላ in unit 17).

sentences.t: ወአማሰኑ ፡ ብርሃኖ ፡ ወደበይዎ ፡ ወዐቀቡ ፡ ዝኅሮ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ወደይዎ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-destroyed light-his and-they-buried-him(?) and-they-guarded store-his(?) where they-put-him;
sentences.i: They destroyed his light, buried him (?), and guarded what was laid up of him (?) in the place where they put him.
sentences.n: አማሰኑ 'they destroyed' (አማሰነ 'ruin, destroy'). ደበይዎ is a verb I cannot place; 'buried him' is from the sequence of the sentence (?); another sense of ill-treatment or sealing in would suit as well. ዐቀቡ 'they guarded' (ዐቀበ). ዝኅሮ 'his store, what is laid up' (ዝኅር 'treasure, store', + 'his'), here perhaps 'his tomb, his remains' (?). ኀበ ወደይዎ 'where they put him' (ወደየ). The three verbs describe the sun killed and sealed away; the passage keeps to the image.

sentences.t: ወወፅአ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ኢተሐዘብዎ ፡ ወአብርሀ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዓለመ ፡ ወፈድፋድሰ ፡ በቀዳሚ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወ ፡ በደኃሪ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ለኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወለሮም ፤
sentences.l: And-he-came-out from-where not they-reckoned-him, and-he-shone all world, and-especially in-first sea and in-last sea, for-Ethiopia and-for-Rome;
sentences.i: But he came out from where they had not expected him, and lit the whole world, above all in the first sea and in the last sea, for Ethiopia and for Rome.
sentences.n: ወፅአ 'he came out'. እምኀበ ኢተሐዘብዎ 'from where they had not reckoned him' (ተሐዘበ 'reckon, expect'). ወፈድፋድሰ 'and above all' (ፈድፋድ + -ሰ). ቀዳሚ ባሕር ወ ፡ በደኃሪ ባሕር: 'first sea' and 'last sea' (ቀዳሚ 'first', ደኃሪ 'last'); the printed text separates the ወ 'and' from the next word by a wordspace. The seas are probably the eastern and western limits of the world, but the text does not say. ለኢትዮጵያ ወለሮም 'for Ethiopia and for Rome'.

sentences.t: ወለእስራኤልሰ ፡ ተሀየዮሙ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወዐርገ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበሩ ፡ ዘትካት ።
sentences.l: And-for-Israel-indeed he-turned-away(?)-them exceedingly, and-he-went-up onto throne-his of-establishment(?).
sentences.i: But toward Israel he turned away (?) all the more, and went up onto his throne, the established one (?).
sentences.n: ወለእስራኤልሰ 'but for Israel'. ተሀየዮሙ ፈድፋደ 'he [turned away] from them exceedingly', the verb as in unit 31 (?). ዐርገ ዲበ መንበሩ 'he went up onto his throne' (ዲበ 'upon'; መንበር 'throne'). ዘትካት: I take ትካት as 'establishment, fixed place' (?), perhaps from the root of ተክለ 'plant, establish', so 'the established throne'; it could mean other things, and I flag it. Ends the dream.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ራእየ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ንዉም ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ደንገፀት ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ ወተመሥጠት ፡ ኅሊናሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ መብረቅ ፡ ወነቅሀ ፡ ድንጉፁ ፨
sentences.l: And-this vision when he-saw, while sleeping, Solomon king, was-startled soul-his and-was-snatched mind-his like lightning, and-he-awoke terrified;
sentences.i: When King Solomon saw this vision in his sleep, his soul was startled, his mind was snatched away like lightning, and he woke terrified.
sentences.n: ዘንተ ራእየ 'this vision' (accusative). ሶበ ርእየ እንዘ ንዉም 'when he saw, while sleeping' (ሶበ 'when'; እንዘ with the participle ንዉም 'one sleeping'). ደንገፀት ነፍሱ 'his soul was startled' (ደንገፀ 'be startled'; ነፍስ is feminine, so the verb is feminine). ተመሥጠት ኅሊናሁ 'his mind was snatched away' (the same verb as unit 28); ከመ መብረቅ 'like lightning'. ነቅሀ ድንጉፁ 'he woke terrified' (ድንጉፅ 'terrified', accusative as a state). Ends at ፨.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ አንከረ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ንግሥት ፡ እስመ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ኀይላ ፡ ወሠናይ ፡ ላሕያ ፡ ወንጽሕት ፡ በድንግልናሃ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-marvelled concerning queen, for strong power-her and-fair beauty-her and-pure in-her-virginity;
sentences.i: He marvelled again at the Queen: her strength was great, her beauty fair, and she was pure in her virginity.
sentences.n: አንከረ 'he marvelled' (አንከረ), በእንተ ንግሥት 'concerning the Queen'. እስመ 'for'. ጽኑዕ ኀይላ 'strong her power' (ኀይል + -ኣ 'her'), ሠናይ ላሕያ 'fair her beauty' (ላሕይ 'beauty, form'), and ንጽሕት በድንግልናሃ 'pure in her virginity' (ድንግልና 'virginity'). These are verbless clauses and carry no tense; the narrator is describing her as she had been.

sentences.t: ወነግሠት ፡ ፮ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ በብሔራ ፡ ወእንዘ ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ተድላሃ ፡ ወክብራ ፡ አንጽሐት ፡ ሥጋሃ ።
sentences.l: And-she-reigned 6 years in-her-land, and-while thus her-delight and-her-glory she-kept-pure body-her.
sentences.i: She had reigned six years in her land, and amid such delight and glory she had kept her body pure.
sentences.n: ነግሠት 'she reigned' (ነግሠ). ፮ is the numeral 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) as in ch. 23; before ዓመተ 'years' (accusative of ዓመት) the numeral may take its own accusative form (ስድስተ), so the exact spoken form is uncertain (?). በብሔራ 'in her land'. ወእንዘ ከመዝ ተድላሃ ወክብራ 'and while such [was] her delight and her glory' (ተድላ 'delight, pleasure'; ከመዝ 'thus'). አንጽሐት ሥጋሃ 'she purified / kept pure her body' (አንጽሐ 'make pure', causative of the root of ንጽሕት 'pure'; ሥጋ 'flesh, body'). The narrator is making a point of her chastity before the tale turns on it.

sentences.t: ወትበሎ ፡ ፈንወኒ ፡ እሖር ፡ ብሔርየ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-said-to-him: Send-me that-I-go land-my;
sentences.i: She said to him: "Send me, that I may go to my land."
sentences.n: ፈንወኒ 'send me' (imperative of ፈነወ + -ኒ); እሖር 'that I go' (subjunctive of ሖረ); ብሔርየ 'my land' (accusative).

sentences.t: ወቦአ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ ወወሀባ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወብዕለ ፡ ወሠናያነ ፡ አልባሰ ፡ ዘየሀይድ ፡ አዕይንተ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወራኩባተ ፡ ወሰረገላተ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ፮ ፡ ሲሕ ፡ ዘጽዑን ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ክብር ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ወሰረገላተ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼዐኑ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ኆጻ ፡ ወሰረገላ ፡ ዘየሐውር ፡ ዲበ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ወሰረገላ ፡ ዘይረውጽ ፡ በነፋሳት ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ በከመ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ዘወሀቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፨
sentences.l: And-he-entered to dwelling-his and-he-gave-her all what is-needed: honor and-wealth, and-beautiful garments which plunder eyes, and-all what is-needed, honor for-land-of Ethiopia, and-mounts-(?) and-carts about 6 thousand-(?) laden with goods-of honor which is-needed, and-carts which carry on sand-(?), and-cart which goes on sea, and-cart which runs on winds, which he-made according-to wisdom which gave-him God.
sentences.i: He went into his dwelling and gave her everything needed: honor and wealth, fine garments that dazzle the eyes, and all that was needed to honor the land of Ethiopia; and mounts (?) and carts, about six thousand (?) of them, laden with the honorable goods that were needed; and carts that carry their loads over sand (?), and a cart that goes on the sea, and a cart that runs upon the winds, which he made according to the wisdom God had given him.
sentences.n: ቦአ ኀበ ማኅደሩ 'he went into his dwelling' (ማኅደር 'dwelling, lodging'). ወወሀባ ኵሎ ዘይትፈቀድ 'and he gave her all that is needed' (ተፈቀደ 'be wished, needed'). ሠናያነ አልባሰ 'beautiful garments' (accusative plural); ዘየሀይድ አዕይንተ 'which plunder the eyes' (ሀየደ, as in unit 3), i.e. dazzle (?). ክብረ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ 'honor for the land of Ethiopia'. ራኩባት I take as 'mounts, riding beasts' (the Arabic sense; camels?) (?). ሰረገላ 'cart, chariot, wagon'. መጠነ 'about, as much as'. ፮ ሲሕ: ፮ is 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu); ሲሕ I read as 'thousand' (the Amharic and Tigrinya word is ሺህ), so 'six thousand' (?). ዘጽዑን 'laden' (ጸዐነ 'load'; ጽዑን, plural). ንዋየ ክብር 'goods of honor'. እለ ይጼዐኑ ዲበ ኆጻ: ኆጻ 'sand' (so glossed in an earlier part), here the ground of sand (?); ይጼዐኑ is the active 3rd plural imperfect of ጸዐነ 'carry, load', so 'which carry' (their loads or riders, the object being unstated) (?). The three carts, on land, sea and wind, are Solomon's own making by the wisdom God gave him (ዘወሀቦ 'which he gave him'); that is as far as the text goes, and no mechanism is given. The unit has about 44 words, kept whole because it has no ፤ to cut at; it ends at ፨.
